about.title: About Ek Punjab Foundation
about.subtitle: Ek Punjab Foundation
about.missionText: To empower communities across Punjab through comprehensive social initiatives in health, education, and community development, creating sustainable positive change and improving quality of life for all.
about.visionText: A prosperous Punjab where every individual has access to quality healthcare, education, and opportunities for growth, where communities thrive together in harmony and dignity.
about.value1Desc: Open and honest in all operations
about.storyText: Founded in 2015, Ek Punjab Foundation emerged from a collective vision to address critical social challenges facing Punjab communities. What began as a small group of dedicated volunteers has grown into a comprehensive organization reaching thousands across the state.
about.leader1Bio: Leading Ek Punjab Foundation's vision with over 20 years of social work experience.
about.leader2Bio: Managing day-to-day operations and program implementation.
about.leader3Bio: Overseeing healthcare programs and medical camps.
about.leader4Bio: Leading educational support and literacy programs.
about.timeline2015: Ek Punjab Foundation founded with focus on healthcare
about.timeline2017: Expanded to education and women empowerment

news1.title: Free Medical Camp Conducted in Ludhiana
news1.excerpt: Ek Punjab Foundation successfully organized a comprehensive medical camp providing free health screenings and consultations to over 500 families in Ludhiana district.

news2.title: Winter Relief Drive Reaches 5,000 Families
news2.excerpt: Distribution of blankets, warm clothing, and essential supplies completed across 8 districts during the winter season, benefiting over 5,000 families.

news3.title: Youth Skill Development Program Launched
news3.excerpt: New initiative aims to provide vocational training and job placement assistance to 1,000 youth across rural Punjab over the next 12 months.

news4.title: Women Empowerment Workshop in Patiala
news4.excerpt: Interactive session on entrepreneurship and financial literacy attended by 200 women from rural communities, with follow-up training scheduled.

news5.title: Blood Donation Camp Saves 100+ Lives
news5.excerpt: Community blood donation drive organized in partnership with Civil Hospital resulted in 250 units of blood collected.

news6.title: Tree Plantation Drive Plants 5,000 Trees
news6.excerpt: Green Punjab Mission achieves milestone with volunteers planting 5,000 trees across 10 villages in Malwa region.

news7.title: Job Fair Announced in Chandigarh Hospital on April 25–26
news7.excerpt: A job fair is set to be organised near Chandigarh Hospital, opposite Solkhian Gurdwara in Ropar on April 25 and 26, offering employment opportunities to job seekers across various sectors.

donate.whyDonateTitle: Why Donate to Ek Punjab Foundation?
donate.whyReason1: 95% of funds go directly to programs
donate.needHelpDesc: For questions about donations or tax exemptions, contact us:
donate.donateDesc: Every contribution helps us continue our mission of empowering communities across Punjab. Your generosity creates lasting change in the lives of thousands.
donate.impact1000: Sponsors a medical camp for 50 families
donate.impact5000: Funds a month of emergency relief services
donate.contactUs: Contact us for CSR partnerships and bulk donations
donate.faq1A: Yes, all donations are eligible for tax deduction under Section 80G of the Income Tax Act.
donate.faq2Q: How will my donation be used?
donate.faq2A: Your donation directly supports our programs in healthcare, education, women empowerment, and emergency relief across Punjab.
donate.faq3Q: Can I cancel my monthly donation?
donate.faq3A: Yes, you can cancel your recurring donation at any time by contacting us or through your donor portal.
donate.faq4Q: Will I receive a donation receipt?
donate.faq4A: Yes, you will receive an email receipt immediately, and an 80G tax certificate will be sent within 48 hours.
